resources.string: Choose the areas to save. Only checked areas will be exported. A password is optional unless you include an API key, clipboard history or saved remote computers.

Choose which areas to restore. Only values present in checked areas will replace matching values; missing and unchecked settings stay unchanged. The reader may restart briefly to apply startup settings.
Copies do not include Android permissions, enabled services, the default keyboard, installed speech engines, downloaded AI models or temporary caches. Install engines and download models separately.
This older copy contains only reader preferences, not the separate braille settings. It may contain an unprotected API key. Only the areas actually found below can be restored.

API keys, clipboard history and saved remote computers are unchecked by default and require a password when exported. Other settings, prompts and labels may also contain private text. Protect copies you share. A forgotten backup password cannot be recovered.
Dot calibration is unchecked by default. Restore it only on the same device/layout; on another screen, calibrate the dots again.

The operation was interrupted. Choose the areas again; no different backup was written.
The copy exceeds the size or available-memory limit. Select fewer areas. Limits: 128 MB per copy, 64 MB of theme files and 5 MB per sound file.
This copy needs password protection for private data.
Incorrect password or damaged encrypted copy. Nothing was imported.
A setting has an incompatible data type. Nothing was imported.
Unlock the device before backing up or restoring private data.
Recovery could not finish. Do not delete the app or clear its data. Retry from Backup and restore; the previous data is kept in a private recovery journal.
Restoration finished. Restarting the reader to apply startup settings. Speech may pause briefly.
The copy was restored, but the running components could not reload. Restart the reader to apply all changes.
